description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {1}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
